note: Empty matrix. No PASA/FALLA. The driver fills a verdict only when pointed at a real server log.

cases.point: AtomicSaveBalances_false after spill staging and sell marker write
cases.prep: Native provider. Player with BTC to sell to account. If account room is below payout, stage spill cash first (expectedCashPayout>0). Catalog valid.
cases.action: HandleBTCSell toAccount=true with amount that reaches AddBalance after WriteSellDestroyIntent.
cases.invariant: BTC and spill EUR still with the player; err INVALID; zero credit; no durable .sell marker.
expect_contains: [BTCSell] account credit differed from preflight before destruction; staged cash aborted and BTC left intact
[LFPG_Balance_Native] Add rollback: balance snapshot was not durable

cases.point: after AddBalance OK, before DestroyPlayerItems
cases.prep: Same as E04 save-false. Note pre-credit Native balance B, credit C, BTC count N. Arm crash JSON. After CRASH_NOW, SIGKILL if the process still lives. Disarm JSON before boot 2.
cases.action: Sell to account. Process dies. Reconnect the same player on boot 2.
cases.invariant: Boot 2: durable credit B+C intact; reconcile destroys N BTC. ObserveReconcile current=B+C destroyed=N.

cases.point: after WriteSellDestroyIntent, before AddBalance
cases.prep: Same as E04. Disarm JSON before boot 2.
cases.action: Sell to account. Die. Reconnect on boot 2.
cases.invariant: BTC intact. Marker cleared because current==balanceBefore. No credit.
expect_contains: sell-intent marker had no durable credit; marker cleared and items left intact

cases.point: ClearSellDestroyIntentAfterDestroy skips DeleteFile; rewrite rebase is allowed
cases.prep: Completed account sell that destroys BTC. Arm this scenario. After the tx, restart and reconnect (JSON disarmed on boot 2).
cases.action: Sell to account to completion. Boot 2 reconnect.
cases.invariant: Third-pass rebase: marker rewritten with balanceBefore=post-credit. Boot 2 must NOT destroy BTC again (current==rebased before).
expect_contains: sell-intent marker could not be cleared after destroy; rebased balanceBefore to current

cases.point: AfterDestroy: skip Clear and skip Write rebase
cases.prep: Completed account sell. remaining=2 so both AfterDestroy hooks fire. Boot 2 reconnect with JSON disarmed.
cases.action: Sell to account to completion. Reconnect.
cases.invariant: Log asks admin to delete .sell. Boot 2 MAY re-destroy BTC if balance still equals before+credit — that is the residue the third pass could not close. Record it; do not call the ficha closed from this lane.
expect_contains: sell-intent marker survived after destroy and could not be rebased

cases.point: SaveFile succeeds, AtomicSaveBalances then returns false without marker and without DiscardAbortedTmp
cases.prep: Prefer first-save (no LF_Balances.json target) or delete the target before the tx so boot 2 sees tmp without target. Trigger any Native save (deposit/sell credit). Disarm JSON before boot 2.
cases.invariant: Boot 2 does not promote the leftover tmp (no .saving). Log: NOT promoting. No credited mutation from the aborted save.
expect_contains: Orphan balances .tmp is not an in-flight replace. NOT promoting
forbid_contains: In-flight balances .tmp parses as LFPG_BalanceData, promoting

cases.point: after DeleteFile(target), before CopyFile(tmp,target); .saving and bak exist
cases.prep: Target and bak must exist before the save (not first-save). SIGKILL after CRASH_NOW. Disarm JSON before boot 2.
cases.action: One Native save. Die inside the replace window. Boot 2.
cases.invariant: Boot 2 MAY promote tmp (in-flight + backup + no target). Log promoting. This is the one crash window recovery is allowed to commit.
expect_contains: In-flight balances .tmp parses as LFPG_BalanceData, promoting

cases.point: CopyFile(tmp,target) skipped; marker cleared; target restored from bak
cases.prep: Existing balances target + bak. One save. Disarm JSON before boot 2.
cases.action: Native save that reaches promote. Restart.
cases.invariant: Reported abort. Boot 2 does not promote leftover tmp. Target is the restored snapshot.
forbid_contains: In-flight balances .tmp parses as LFPG_BalanceData, promoting

cases.point: CopyFile promote + DeleteFile .saving + restore CopyFile + DiscardAbortedTmp all fail in one save
cases.prep: Existing target. remaining=8. Disarm JSON before boot 2. REVIEW-T1 MENOR: this is the residual (b) stack.
cases.invariant: If .tmp parseable + .saving + bak survive with no target, boot 2 CAN promote an aborted mutation. Record the log. This is the residue T1 left open; do not green-wash it.
expect_contains: in-flight marker survived a reported abort

cases.point: ReconcileRefundedChain after LFPG_ApplyClaimedStockTarget, before return (tombstones kept)
cases.prep: ATM with REFUNDED tombstones whose restoredStock != loaded hive stock. SIGKILL. Disarm JSON. Boot 2 loads the ATM again.
cases.action: Boot 1 reconciles and dies after apply. Boot 2 loads the same ATM.
cases.invariant: Tombstones still in JSON (no PersistRemoveDeviceClaimPrefix on this path). Boot 2 must not double-compensate. Watch Late ATM matched refunded tombstone twice vs compact on stock match.
expect_contains: Late ATM matched refunded tombstone; stock compensation applied, tombstones kept

cases.point: none — operational. SweepOrphanClaims / AdvanceOrPruneRefundedClaimAt
cases.prep: ATM that was refunded, then packed/out of bubble so it is absent from LFPG_DeviceRegistry. Keep the tombstone JSON. Three clean boots of orphan sweep, then reappear the ATM with old hive stock.
cases.action: Boots N, N+1, N+2 absent. Boot N+3 reappear.
cases.invariant: After the second T1 pass, bootsSinceRefund+1>=3 must NOT PersistRemoveClaimAt. Tombstone remains. Reappear applies compensation once. Refund+stock must not both stay.

cases.point: none — ReconcileRefundedChain compact when stock already matches
cases.prep: After a successful compensate-and-keep-tombstone boot, hive stock already equals restoredStock.
cases.action: Next boot with ATM present and pendingCount==0.
cases.invariant: Log: hive stock already matched refunded compensation; tombstones cleared durably.
expect_contains: Late ATM hive stock already matched refunded compensation; tombstones cleared durably

cases.point: none — input. Optional observe JSON remaining=0 for OBSERVE tx line
cases.prep: Player with zero catalog bills. Catalog valid. Request maxBtcPerMachine cash buy.
cases.invariant: Zero BTC entities created. err NO_CASH (10). ProbeAndCacheStack is NOT reached (returns before warmup).

cases.point: none — input
cases.prep: Player bills cover K < requested BTC at current price. Catalog valid.
cases.action: Cash buy requesting more than affordable.
cases.invariant: Partial delivery of affordable BTC. Bills consumed only for that. Log [BTCBuy] cash: K BTC.

cases.point: none — input
cases.prep: Player can pay but inventory cannot accept BTC and/or change (fill cargo).
cases.invariant: AbortOutputs; no bill consumption. OBSERVE err INVENTORY_FULL (6) moved=0.

cases.point: none — input. Currency value 1, stack 1, amount that needs 65 entities
cases.prep: Catalog: one denomination classname with value=1 and GetQuantityMax==1 (probe). Player can pay. Request cash buy/sell/withdraw whose Estimate*Entities is 65.
cases.action: The op that would spawn 65 entities.
cases.invariant: AMOUNT_TOO_LARGE (14), zero spawn except the controlled probe create+delete. Error entity budget exceeded / entity budget rejected.

cases.point: none — input. Same config, 64 entities exactly
cases.prep: Same as E03_65 but amount that estimates 64.
cases.invariant: Op is not rejected for budget. Cap is 64 (LFPG_BTC_MAX_ENTITIES_PER_TX).

cases.point: none — input. BTC classname stack 1, withdraw 65
cases.prep: btcItemClassname with GetQuantityMax==1. ATM stock >=65. Withdraw 65.
cases.invariant: AMOUNT_TOO_LARGE before spawn. Log [BTCWithdraw] rejected: entity budget exceeded before spawn.
expect_contains: [BTCWithdraw] rejected: entity budget exceeded before spawn

cases.point: LF_BTCAtm.json catalog, not a code hook. Load() once per boot.
cases.prep: Two currency entries with the same classname. Restart so Load() runs.
cases.action: Boot, then any cash op (buy/sell/withdraw/deposit cash).
cases.invariant: CURRENCY CATALOG REFUSED. Duplicate currency classname logged. Cash ops INVALID. No cash spawn/credit.
expect_contains: CURRENCY CATALOG REFUSED - ALL CASH OPERATIONS ARE DISABLED

cases.point: LF_BTCAtm.json — Paper_Bill_100 and PAPER_BILL_100 (second T1 pass ToLower)
cases.prep: Same classname twice with different case. Restart.
cases.invariant: Catalog refused (ToLower before Find). Same logs as duplicates.
expect_contains: CURRENCY CATALOG REFUSED - ALL CASH OPERATIONS ARE DISABLED

cases.point: LF_BTCAtm.json currency classname == btcItemClassname
cases.prep: Set a currency.classname equal to btcItemClassname. Restart.
cases.invariant: Currency classname overlaps btcItemClassname. Catalog refused.
expect_contains: CURRENCY CATALOG REFUSED - ALL CASH OPERATIONS ARE DISABLED

cases.point: LF_BTCAtm.json empty classname or class not in CfgVehicles/CfgMagazines/CfgWeapons
cases.prep: One entry classname empty, or a garbage classname. Restart.
cases.invariant: empty classname OR not a Cfg* class. Catalog refused.
expect_contains: CURRENCY CATALOG REFUSED - ALL CASH OPERATIONS ARE DISABLED

cases.point: LF_BTCAtm.json currencies [null] or []
cases.prep: Nulls stripped; empty after that fails closed. Restart. A fresh install with empty defaults also hits this.
cases.invariant: Currency catalog empty after null removal. Cash ops disabled. Account buy/sell still allowed.
expect_contains: CURRENCY CATALOG REFUSED - ALL CASH OPERATIONS ARE DISABLED

cases.point: none — deploy gate from REVIEW-T1 GRAVE E08
cases.prep: Copy the LIVE server LF_BTCAtm.json onto a DIAG box with this code.
cases.invariant: If the live JSON fails any of the seven rules, ALL cash ops die until an admin edits JSON and restarts. This case is the deploy gate, not a code defect.

cases.point: none — input. SelectPreparedCashExact before first AddBalance
cases.prep: Player holds a single bill of 100. Deposit 60. Catalog valid. Native has room.
cases.invariant: Zero AtomicSaveBalances. Cash intact. Log: amount is not representable with prepared bills; no account mutation. OBSERVE tx=6 err=9.
expect_contains: [BTCDepositCash] amount is not representable with prepared bills; no account mutation

cases.point: none — input. Native room 30, exact bills for 30
cases.prep: Player balance cap-30. Bills that greedy-exact to 30. Deposit 100 (clamped to room 30).
cases.invariant: One save. Credit 30. Bills of 30 consumed.

cases.point: none — input. Room 30, bills [50,50] (exact 30 impossible)
cases.prep: Native room 30. Player bills 50+50. Deposit 100 -> requestedCredit=30, SelectPreparedCashExact(30) fails.
cases.invariant: Zero saves. Cash intact.
expect_contains: [BTCDepositCash] amount is not representable with prepared bills; no account mutation

cases.point: AddBalance_partial: force toAdd=1 after room clamp, then save that partial
cases.prep: Representable deposit (e.g. bill 50, deposit 50). remaining=1 so RemoveBalance revert can still save.
cases.invariant: creditedCash != requestedCredit; revert attempted. Cash not committed. Log account credit mismatch path.
